subject: Discovery recap + proposed 75m infra runthrough (Novapulse)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Abe Hernandez <abe.hernandez@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed 75m infra runthrough (Novapulse)

Hi Abe —

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery earlier today. Quick recap + clear next steps so we keep momentum:

Recap (high level):
- Primary use case: real-time recommendations for checkout, low single-digit percent latency SLO on inference (95th percentile).
- Data flow: event stream -> batch ingestion to S3 -> nearline feature service -> model scoring.
- Constraints: multi-tenant data isolation, SOC2 evidence for logs, want on VPC-enabled Dedicated or Private runbook.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute technical runthrough with our ML/Infra engineers and your platform/SRE team to:
1) Walk your current infra and traffic profile
2) Review model serving options, batching and KV cache sizing
3) Discuss security/compliance checkpoints (KMS, audit logs)
4) Align on rollout plan and owners

Who from our side: Ben Carter (solutions lead) + Marissa Cole (serving engineer).
Who we'd like from your side: infra/SRE + platform owner (if possible).

Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue 9/21: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Wed 9/22: 11:30–12:45 or 15:00–16:15
- Thu 9/23: 09:00–10:15

I've attached a short prep packet (novapulse-mrp-mapping.xlsx) that helps us size KV caches and sample tokenization characteristics — could you drop in a sample traffic CSV or confirm which of the above windows works?

If none work, tell us 2x slots that fit your team and we will prioritize.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---
Attachment: novapulse-mrp-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34kb)

Date: 2027-09-18T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed 75m infra runthrough (Novapulse)

Laura —

Thanks for the clear recap and the prep doc. We are definitely interested in an infra-level session — I want our SRE lead (Maya) and our platform PM (Jamal) there. Confirming a couple of points:

- Our traffic profile is bursty with spikes at 300–400 rps for 30–60s windows. Hope that aligns with what you need for sizing.
- We have a SOC2 analyst (contact copied to platform-admin@novapulse.ai) who will want to review the audit-log approach.

Of the windows you suggested, Wed 9/22 15:00–16:15 PT works best for us. If you can lock that, I will send an invite and pull the SRE lead in.

I'll also upload a 1-hour traffic sample to the shared folder by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the deep dive.

—Abe
Abe Hernandez
Head of Platform, Novapulse
abe.hernandez@novapulse.ai
+1 (650) 555-0199

Laura / Marissa —

Wed 9/22 15:00–16:15 PT works for me. Quick internal plan so we show up prepared:

Proposed 75-minute agenda (tight):
- 0–10m: Introductions + success criteria (Laura)
- 10–30m: Novapulse infra & traffic profile review (Abe / Novapulse)
- 30–50m: Serving options & tradeoffs (Marissa) — continuous batching, KV cache sizing, quantization considerations
- 50–60m: Security/compliance checklist (Ben) — KMS, audit logs, VPC patterns
- 60–70m: Rollout plan & owners (Laura)
- 70–75m: Quick Q&A and next steps

Attendees from our side: Ben (serving design + compliance), Marissa (engineer, demo), Laura (AM). Can we make Marissa own the demo and Ben own compliance section?

Also — Marissa, can you prepare a 5–7 minute demo of a cached inference path (20-token sample) and a short slide with recommended cache sizes for 300–400 rps bursts? If you want, I can pre-compute a rough table from the novapulse-mrp-mapping.xlsx and share.

Ben
